analysis:
On 18 September 2009, Chidambaram said the Rs 2,000 crore CCTNS project would link all 16,000 police stations and become operational by 2011-12, a target that implied completion by 31 March 2012.

In December 2014 the Home Ministry told Parliament that CCTNS was 'lagging behind schedule'. Only 58% of crime records had been digitised, Rs 806 crore of the Rs 2,000 crore outlay had been released, and a senior ministry official said end-2015 was a more realistic date for seamless connectivity.

The project did eventually expand, but the 2011-12 target was not met. The pilot phase itself was launched only on 4 January 2013, after the stated deadline.
notes: The 2009-09-18 date is from contemporaneous reports of the launch; DNA's page carries a later update stamp. The quote is the wording reported by The Economic Times and The Hindu, not a transcript. '2011-12' is treated as the Indian financial year ending 31 March 2012.
